queries.ident: SELECT i.id AS q, i2.id AS other FROM ident AS i JOIN ident AS i2 ON i.oidref = i2.oidref WHERE i.id IN ({ids}) AND (i2.id LIKE 'Gaia DR3 %' OR i2.id LIKE 'HIP %')
queries.simbad: SELECT i.id AS q, b.main_id, b.plx_value, b.plx_err, b.plx_qual, b.plx_bibcode FROM ident AS i JOIN basic AS b ON i.oidref = b.oid WHERE i.id IN ({ids})
queries.gaia: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, parallax_error, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved, phot_g_mean_mag, nu_eff_used_in_astrometry, pseudocolour, ecl_lat FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE source_id IN ({ids})
queries.hipparcos_neighbour: SELECT n.source_id, h.hip, h.plx, h.e_plx FROM gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS n JOIN public.hipparcos_newreduction AS h ON h.hip = n.original_ext_source_id WHERE n.source_id IN ({ids})
queries.hipparcos: SELECT hip, plx, e_plx FROM public.hipparcos_newreduction WHERE hip IN ({ids})
queries.distance: SELECT source_id, r_med_geo, r_lo_geo, r_hi_geo FROM external.gaiaedr3_distance WHERE source_id IN ({ids})
